card.name: The letter b starting a split word
card.fires_on: The piece "b" or "B" that begins a word split into parts, such as B-irth, b-riefer, B-read, or cross-b-ills. It is strongest when the next piece continues to "ir", "ri", or "re".

modes.label: Birth in warnings
modes.description: Capital B starting "BIRTH" in all-caps warning text about pregnancy.
modes.example: WARNINGS MISOPROSTOL ADMINISTRATION TO WOMEN WHO ARE PREGNANT CAN CAUSE<< B>>IRTH DEFECTS, ABORTION

modes.label: Briefer in opioid text
modes.description: Lowercase b starting "briefer" after "taking opioids for".
modes.example: Patients who have been taking opioids for<< b>>riefer periods of time may tolerate a

modes.label: Other split b-words
modes.description: A b that begins a compound or rare word in general web text, such as dinosaur-bird or crossbills.
modes.example: Early ornithologists wrote of the curious absence of red cross<<b>>ills in the Siskiyous.

card.plain: It fires on a lone letter b that starts a word the model has broken into pieces, like birth or briefer.
